english.title: Importer place pyrotechnic (not F1/F2/F3 firework) on market of EU State w/o translated EU declaration of conformity
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) was the importer of a pyrotechnic article other than a category F1, F2 or F3 firework, namely **(..SPECIFY PYROTECHNIC ARTICLE..), and placed it on the market having failed to ensure that the EU declaration of conformity was prepared in, or translated into, the language required by the member State in which it was to be made available on the market, namely **(..SPECIFY THE MEMBER STATE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 36, 62(2)(q) and 63(2) of the Pyrotechnic Articles (Safety) Regulations 2015.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
an importer
placed a pyrotechnic article on the market
failed to ensure
the EU declaration of conformity was prepared in / translated into the language required

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Where this offence is committed in respect of a pyrotechnic article to which regulation 63(1) applies (i.e. a category F1, F2 or F3 firework), it is summary only - see offence document H12321 (CJS code PA15084)
(ii) Where the pyrotechnic articles is to be made available on the market in the United Kingdom, the language required is English

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and/or a fine
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
None
